data.exact_reserve_text: The overall result in 2023 benefitted from the higher yield investment environment and a prior year reserve release of GBP 13.4m. The surpluses / (deficits) following the reassessment of claims outstanding held at the end of the previous year are set out below.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Estimate for net losses arising from the Russia/Ukraine war is held as IBNR covering War on Land, Aviation War and Credit and Political Risk losses; considerable uncertainty remains and management continually monitor potential loss development and reinsurance responsiveness.

named_events.loss_description: Division was impacted by CAT losses arising from the tragic Turkey/Syria earthquakes.
Estimate for net losses arising from the Russia/Ukraine war is currently held at GBP 18.0m of IBNR covering War on Land, Aviation War and CPRI.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2023 were GBP 910.762m. During 2023 management recorded a gross prior-year strengthening of GBP 78.241m driven by a reassessment of prior years' claims. Causes cited include large natural catastrophe activity (notably the Turkey/Syria earthquakes affecting reinsurance/property treaty business), geopolitical losses related to the Russia/Ukraine war (for which net IBNR of GBP 18.0m is held), and recalibration for inflationary pressures (an explicit excess inflation IBNR held). Despite the gross strengthening, the strategic report also notes a net prior year release of GBP 13.4m (after reinsurance), reflecting recoveries and reinsurance effects.

data.data_quality_notes: Primary gross prior-year movement used is the 'Change in prior underwriting year's provisions' line from the Technical Provisions (gross) table (+GBP 78.241m). The strategic narrative reports a net prior year release of GBP 13.4m (after reinsurance) which is consistent but opposite in sign when netting reinsurance recoveries; users should note difference between gross movement and net reported release. Per-LOB prior-year figures are taken from the 'surpluses/(deficits) following the reassessment...' table; that table groups 'Marine, aviation and transport' together - mapping that group to the single standard LOB 'Marine' is approximate. All monetary amounts are reported in millions. Confidence levels are indicated per field where interpretation or mapping was required.
